services.text: Services Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of mining and commodity inputs against their own trailing 5-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 20.7 in September 2026, it is above its 5-year norm; it rose from 18.0 a month earlier but is below 25.5 three months earlier. ABS mining capex expectations is the largest positive contributor (+10.8), while NSW coal export value is the largest negative contributor (-5.0).

products.text: Products Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At 36.4 in October 2026, it is above its five-year norm and has risen from 30.4 a month earlier and 12.8 six months earlier. US new orders for iron and steel mills are the biggest positive contributor (+25.0), while inverted AUD/USD is the largest negative (-9.0); AISI capacity utilisation and discontinued CAT retail sales are excluded.

margin.text: Margin Pulse tracks weighted z-scores of its inputs against their own trailing five-year norms, scaled from -100 to +100. At -12.0 in October 2026, it is below its five-year norm, improving from -24.0 a month earlier but below -10.8 three months earlier and 16.1 a year earlier. Fitter/welder vacancy tightness is the biggest positive contributor (+8.9), while AUD/USD is the biggest negative (-21.0); the tungsten policy proxy is excluded pending sufficient history.

technology.text: The pipeline holds 2 leads, 4 agreements, 1 cell ordered and 3 commissioned cells, with $4.8 million in stated contracted value, all unrecognised. Over the past six months it added 2 leads, 4 agreements, 1 cell order and 3 commissioned cells, including Komatsu’s $2.4 million first licensing agreement and a second cell ordered for Perth.
